question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Repressed**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Repressed **means to suppress or restrain something, often emotions or desires. (किसी चीज़ को दबाना या रोकना)
 
• The word is in past participle form, indicating that something has already been repressed.
 
 
• **Example**: She repressed her anger and
